page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Account sync, video sources and backups

templates.title: Video sources
templates.description: Sites you can pick when generating links. Use '{code}' where the code goes.

backup.title: Data & backup
backup.description: {playlists, plural, one {# playlist} other {# playlists}} with {items, plural, one {# code} other {# codes}}. Export a backup file, or restore from one.
backup.imported: Imported {count, plural, one {# playlist} other {# playlists}}
backup.restored: Restored {count, plural, one {# playlist} other {# playlists}}
backup.clearDevice: Clear all data on this device

clear.title: Clear all data?
clear.description: This deletes {count, plural, one {# playlist} other {# playlists}} and all custom sources, and can't be undone.
clear.cloudNote: You're signed in, so the cloud copy and other synced devices will be cleared too.

account.title: Account & sync
account.signedInDescription: Playlists and custom sources sync automatically to every device you're signed in on.
account.signedOutDescription: Sign in with Google to sync playlists between your phone and computer. Everything works without signing in too.
account.googleUnavailable: Couldn't reach Google. Please try again later
account.profileLoadFailed: Couldn't load your profile. You may be offline.
account.signOutDescription: Your cloud data is kept and comes back the next time you sign in. On a shared device, consider removing the data on this device as well.
account.signOutKeep: Sign out, keep data on this device
account.pendingChanges: Some changes haven't been uploaded yet. Please go online and try again
account.signedOutRemoved: Signed out and removed the data on this device

syncErrors.offline: You're offline. Sync will resume when you're back online.
syncErrors.network: Couldn't reach the sync server. Check your connection and try again.
syncErrors.auth: Your session has expired. Sign out and sign in again.
syncErrors.permission: The server rejected this sync. Try signing in again, and let us know if it keeps happening.
syncErrors.unknown: Something went wrong while syncing. Your changes are still saved on this device; try again in a moment.

profileFields.showEmailHint: Hidden by default. Others only see your nickname and avatar.
profileFields.notPublicYet: Nothing is public yet. These settings take effect once community features launch.
profileFields.tagsHint: Press Enter or comma to add. Up to {count} tags, {length} characters each.

onboarding.syncLocal: The {count, plural, one {# playlist} other {# playlists}} on this device will sync to your account
onboarding.backupAuto: Your playlists are backed up to your account automatically
onboarding.mergeBody: They merge with the playlists already in your account; nothing gets overwritten.
onboarding.autoSyncBody: Syncs when you edit, switch back to the app, or reconnect. No need to save manually.
onboarding.devicesBody: Sign in with the same Google account on your phone or computer to see them.
onboarding.profileTitle: How do you want to appear?
onboarding.profileDescription: You can change this anytime in Settings.

stats.title: Trending stats
stats.description: The rankings on the <link>Explore</link> page come from codes saved and links clicked by signed-in users. Only aggregated counts are shown, never who you are or what you saved, and a code is only listed once at least 3 people have it.
stats.participate: Count my saves and clicks in trending stats
stats.left: You've opted out of trending stats. This applies from the next ranking update
stats.failed: Couldn't update the setting. Please try again later

replace.title: Replace your current data?
replace.description: Your {playlists, plural, one {# playlist} other {# playlists}} with {items, plural, one {# code} other {# codes}} and all custom sources will be replaced by the backup file's contents.
replace.cloudNote: You're signed in, so the cloud copy and other synced devices will be replaced too.
